correctness.rationale: Multiplication of exact 2x2 heavy-ball matrices produces determinant beta^2 and trace (1+beta-z)(1+beta-rz)-2beta. With both frozen components Schur stable, all but one Jury inequalities are automatic, leaving the displayed positive quadratic H. Its vertex enters the admissible domain exactly at r=3; optimizing H in interior versus at an excluded endpoint produces the two exact contrast branches meeting at beta=2-sqrt(3). The sign of H at the step ceiling classifies two-interval reentrance; exact roots determine both windows. A rational example has exact matrix and eigenvalues with a negative multiplier of modulus greater than one. The checker verifies symbolic identities and selected samples; infinite parameter claims are proved algebraically.

value.rationale: This is a complete and sharp stability phase diagram of a natural two-sample cyclic incremental momentum algorithm, not just a perturbative or isolated unstable example. The momentum threshold beta=2-sqrt(3) separates regimes with and without possible disconnected safe learning-rate windows; a fully explicit strongly convex sample pair reverses the intuition that smaller steps within the individually safe interval must be safer. The exact factor and threshold support momentum tuning and robust scheduling benchmarks without requiring an unjustified nonlinear extension.
